body:
Cannot implement #1877 against upstream/main 8719d8b7a028f0c93cc78fe32ccbfdf5297a0dca yet.
The required prerequisites #1873 and #1874 remain open. Format qualification #1875 also remains open.
No open PR provides these prerequisites, so there is no prerequisite head to stack on.

ImportModel::within still accepts only path and facet_budget. ImportModel has no unit override or resolved source-unit field.
The importer supports only STL, OBJ and STEP. The STEP parser still uses mm_per_unit.unwrap_or(1.0) for missing units.
The cadmpeg runner and qualified native-format table are absent.
#1873 also records an unresolved cadmpeg formats --json capability contract.

The expected API files are crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs and crates/app/src/script/api.rs.
The guide is .claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md.
Planned pins would live in crates/app/tests/mcp_import_units.rs and crates/app/tests/script_import_units.rs.
The decision file would be docs/decisions/1877-import-units.md.
I also checked crates/app/src/commands/import_model.rs for overlap.
PRs #1738, #1817 and #1900 touch the same files, different functions or guide sections; whichever merges second refreshes.

I stopped before claiming or creating a worktree. No code changed and no tests ran.
Resume #1877 when the prerequisite APIs and qualified formats are available. Implementing those other issues here would exceed this worker's one-issue scope.
